Every admin page: blue top bar (64px), a 48px icon rail and the grey content area. The section panel (198px) is closed when the page loads and opens from the rail. The starters have the exact markup: keep it as it is and change only the active section, the rail icons, the panel items, the breadcrumbs and the title.

```
Top bar         64px  sticky top:0          z 1000   brand RPP70 (#014CB7): establishment · date range | notifications · help · account
Side bar        48px  sticky under top bar   z 1000   white rail, padding 8px 0; items 48px tall with a 32px status square
                                                     (hover N-10, active B-20), 24px icons in RPP70
Section panel  198px  sticky under top bar   z 1000   closed on load; a rail icon opens its section's pages;
                                                     choosing a page, clicking outside or Escape closes it
Content               flex 1, padding 16, background #F8F8F8: breadcrumbs → page title (h4) → kit-toolbar → kit-stack of tiles
```
- Sizes come from the Figma spec in `Sidebar.mdx` (Visual specifications), which QA matches. The Storybook Navigation composition (32px buttons 8px apart, 220px panel) is a demo and differs: do not copy it.
- The current rail item has `rp-side-bar-item-active`, `data-rp-current` and `aria-controls` = its panel id. The current page in the panel has `rp-side-bar-panel-item-active`.
- Other rail items open the real section list (shared.js builds it from the production navigation).
- Rail icons are the sections the account has. The starters show all 14; a copied screenshot keeps exactly its icons, in its order.
- A dot on a rail icon (QA shows one on Dynamic Dashboard): wrap the icon in `rp-badge rp-badge-dot` with an empty `rp-badge-content`.
- Items pinned to the bottom go after `rp-side-bar-spacer`. QA shows a blue lightbulb button there: `rp-side-bar-item rp-side-bar-item-contained` with `rp-icon rp-icon-size-20 rp-icon-light-bulb`. It is not in `@reviewpro/ui-components`: add it only when the screenshot has it.
- QA screenshots have a green top bar. Mockups always use the blue one; `rp-top-bar-qa` exists only to show the QA environment on purpose (the checker warns about it).
- Content width: full by default; `rp-content-wrapper-constrained` limits it to 80% (max 1660px) like the new navigation proposal for non-dashboard pages.
- Breakpoints: theme sm 768, md 980, lg 1440. Mockups are built at 1440px.

## Rules
- Never a page without the shell (except embeddable widgets and guest-facing pages, which are out of scope for this kit).
- Establishment selection lives only in the top bar selector: no "hotel / group view" toggles.
- The page title (`rp-page-title`) is mandatory on dashboards and list pages; the settings hub shows only the breadcrumb.
